kind: Bounded source audit, not runtime verification; exactly three HTTP operations

event.reason: Successful source branch explicitly publishes; conditional types are enumerated.
event.producer: CreateProject -> Handler.publish -> Bus.Publish; ActorType member, ActorID requireUserID/requestUserID (not resolved creator actor)

payload.project:created: {project: ProjectResponse}; metadata with resource_count, no resources array
payload.project_resource:created: {resource: ProjectResourceResponse, project_id: project UUID}; once per inserted resource, request order

event.scope: WorkspaceID resolved by handler; no task/chat/member-private hint. Audience lookup narrows existing private projects to project members, no admin bypass; lookup error drops. project:* invalidates cache. Deleted project no longer in private map => workspace fanout, including private deletion ID; visibility becoming workspace similarly widens.
event.transaction: No resources and workspace visibility: single CreateProject INSERT, publish after return. Otherwise Begin/create/private members+visibility/resources/Commit, then project event and resource events. No members_changed on private create.
event.consumer: Generic project prefix invalidates project/workflow/issue-table/saved-view queries. members_changed shares project prefix. project_resource prefix has no generic handler in this dispatcher; no resource-specific frontend listener found in packages/core.

branches: N resources => project:created then N project_resource:created
nonempty prepared addIDs => project:members_changed then project:updated
cascaded resources and detached issues => no per-resource or per-issue bus events

gaps: Go publication is synchronous in-process and outside DB write/commit; no durable outbox, delivery acknowledgement or replay here. A crash after write and before publish loses events; multiple publishes can be partial. Python caller-owned outbox should atomically persist intended event rows with mutation, then dispatch after commit; this is a migration requirement, not implemented/runtime evidence. Search change records are data writes, not additional bus events.
